let lift = groove * 0.6 + sway - drift * 0.35

    v + amount * 0.5
fn soften(v, amount):
    v * amount + 0.05

state warmth(0.3)
state push(0.7)
state drift(0.2)
let raise = energy * 0.6 + 0.2
let tone = warmth * 0.9 + raise * 0.1
let dim = tone - (energy * 0.15)
let crest = dim + (warmth * 0.25)
let edge = push * crest - raise * 0.2
let sway = drift * 0.5 + edge * 0.1
fn blend(v, mix):
    v * (1.0 - mix) + raise * mix
fn lift(v, amount):
    v + amount * drift

fn regress(value, generation): value - (decay * generation) + (seed / generation)
